summary: Mangoceuticals (MGRX) filed an 8-K disclosing the mutual termination, dated August 19, 2026, of its July 29, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with Nuclea Energy Inc. and the Principal Nuclea Shareholders. The deal collapsed because the required PIPE financing of at least $15,000,000 was not deposited into escrow ahead of the August 21, 2026 Outside Date, failing Section 10.1(k). No break fee applies; each side bears its own costs, the BCA is void except surviving confidentiality and general provisions, and mutual releases were exchanged, preserving only willful-breach claims. Watch for renewed financing or alternate counterparty interest.
